checks.name: predeclared-fold-boundaries
checks.detail: Fold remains frozen at 30/40, 40/50, or 50/60 development boundaries.

checks.name: nmax48-origin-schedule-retained
checks.detail: Only the Phase-3C-R Nmax=48 legal origin schedule is retained; Nmax is not an input feature.

checks.name: development-prefix-only
checks.detail: No final 40% partition is constructed as a split.

checks.name: hourly-aggregation-is-causal
checks.detail: Hourly raw sources do not exceed the observation's origin time.

checks.name: nmax-windows-are-split-contained
checks.detail: Every inherited Nmax=48 history and H=24 target remains within its fold.

checks.name: input-times-precede-targets
checks.detail: The last N=15 input time precedes the h=1 target time.

checks.name: no-final-row-in-windows
checks.detail: No input or target reaches the final 40% partition.

checks.name: n15-is-legal-nmax-window-suffix
checks.detail: N=15 is exactly the final suffix of a legal Nmax=48 source window.

checks.name: origin-anchor-is-observed-utot
checks.detail: The anchor is the observed Utot at prediction origin.

checks.name: residual-label-is-future-minus-origin
checks.detail: Target is Utot(t+h)-Utot(t); no target-derived variable becomes input.

checks.name: representation-is-origin-local
checks.detail: Absolute uses raw legal history; relative subtracts only observed Utot(t) from that same history.

checks.name: relative-origin-lag-is-exactly-zero
checks.detail: Relative U(t)-U(t) is exactly zero at every origin.

checks.name: input-scaler-fits-current-representation-train-only
checks.detail: Each input representation has its own scaler fit on its current-fold train inputs only.

checks.name: residual-scaler-fits-train-only
checks.detail: Residual scaler uses current-fold train residuals only.

checks.name: phase3d-output-is-isolated
checks.detail: Output must be exclusively under outputs_phase3d.
